title: Hearing loss not treated with cochlear implantation
summary: Hearing loss in the better ear meeting one of: pure-tone average ≥90 dB AND bone conduction average ≥60 dB, OR word recognition score 40% or less.

children.criterion: Average air conduction hearing threshold of 90 decibels (dB) or greater in the better ear AND average bone conduction hearing threshold of 60 dB or greater in the better ear (at 500, 1000, and 2000 Hz)
Word recognition score of 40% or less in the better ear, determined using a standardized list of phonetically balanced monosyllabic words
